messages:
sara: quick sync — we need a dependency map + rollout plan for the token-cost attribution pipeline. goal: land event schema change and latency tags by next milestone (May 3). who owns the schema change + who can sign off infra?

jordan: I can own the schema PR. plan is to add attribution fields to the generation_event: attribution.tokens_user, attribution.tokens_model, and attribution.cost_usd. also adding latency.breakdown array (name,duration_ms).

mike: thanks. can you show a minimal example of the latency.breakdown shape? ops want to know storage/ingest/serve splits.

jordan: sure — example:
```json
{
  "event": "generation_complete",
  "attribution": {"tokens_user": 32, "tokens_model": 128, "cost_usd": 0.004},
  "latency": {"total_ms": 210, "breakdown": [{"name":"kv_cache","duration_ms":15}, {"name":"service_queue","duration_ms":35}, {"name":"model_infer","duration_ms":160}]}
}
```

anya: infra notes — adding the new fields is fine, but we need a schema migration plan for the event consumer (analytics and billing). recommend: write consumer-compatible defaulting (if attribution missing -> treat as legacy), and add a short TTLed compatibility feature flag on the topic. I can provision a new topic with 7-day retention for the canary.

sara: ownership: jordan = schema PR + test vectors, mike = billing consumer changes + smoke tests, anya = topic + canary infra + rollout gating. i will drive the rollout plan doc and coordinate signoffs. sound right?

mike: yes. mike: I'll add a small adapter in billing to compute cost from tokens_user/tokens_model if present, otherwise fallback to current token_count. Will open PR today. ping me for code review: @sara.

jordan: PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/events/pull/482 — includes schema JSON, README with sample events, and pytest cases. requesting review from @mike and @sara.

deploy-bot: deploy-check: new topic provisioned in staging: events-attrib-canary (retention=7d) — status: done.

anya: infra checklist for rollout: 1) create canary topic (done), 2) enable consumer compatibility flag, 3) deploy schema PR to staging, 4) run 1e5 sample events through canary, 5) monitor error rate & billing diffs for 48h, 6) promote to prod. I'll own gating (#2 and #6).

sara: timeline: jordan PR by EOD, mike PR by EOD, canary ingest test tomorrow morning, decision Friday AM. blockers?

mike: possible blocker: billing tests depend on sample token pricing table — @finance needs to confirm per-token price used in dev. I'll flag in PR.

jordan: small note: please avoid renaming existing fields; add new nested objects only. analytics queries will need a one-time backfill script after prod.

sara: ok — next steps for each: jordan -> tag schema PR with TEST-VECTORS, mike -> open billing adaptor PR and include sample results, anya -> schedule canary ingest + share dashboard, sara -> compile rollout doc and send to the cross-team channel for signoffs.

deploy-bot: reminder: schedule maintenance window is optional for canary; no downtime expected.

sara: thanks all — i'll drop the rollout doc link here when ready. :thumbsup:
